qualification.direct_parity_rule: For every case, normalized text must be identical across direct-local, direct-remote, pd-local and pd-remote.
qualification.separate_transfer_requirement: Each P/D request must add exactly one transfer; all failure deltas zero.
qualification.settings: Qwen3-0.6B pinned revision; BF16 TP1 block64 eager max-seqs4 max-batched8192 prefix cache off. Identical settings on all engines.

selection_rule: Using one seeded RNG, sample eight distinct words from the declared 16-word pool for each case in recorded case order.
